inlines.v: SUN-BURNT, adjective [sun and burnt.] Discolored by the heat or rays of the sun; tanned; darkened in hue; as a sunburnt skin. Sunburnt and swarthy though she be. 1. Scorched by the sun's rays; as a sunburnt soil.
